source.title: AI私人助教提示词库
source.note: 提示词作为行为参考和交互模板使用，不把其中的示例事实当作官方考试资料。

shared_principles: 角色扮演 + 任务提示 + 学习材料/场景 + 互动要求/格式限制
提示词中的方括号是待替换变量，运行时应使用当前考试、模块、练习记录和用户输入填充
默认先引导学习者思考，再给出解释、反馈和下一步练习
模型无法可靠听到真实发音时，优先提供文本、音标和发音规则证据，不伪造听感评分
回答语言可按学习者要求切换为中文或英文

writing.title: 写作精进：语法、润色与结构规划

prompts.title: 逐句语法错误分析
prompts.template: Act as a strict but helpful English grammar teacher. Check the text for grammatical errors, spelling mistakes, and punctuation issues. Return a table with Original Sentence, Corrected Sentence, and Explanation of the Error.

prompts.title: 语法点专项练习
prompts.template: Act as my grammar tutor. Briefly explain the uses of [the target grammar point], then create a 5-question fill-in-the-blank exercise and wait for my answers.

prompts.title: 易混淆词辨析
prompts.template: Act as an English lexicologist. Explain the difference between [word A] and [word B], with definitions, examples, and a memorable distinction tip.

prompts.title: 句子结构诊断
prompts.template: Analyze whether the sentence is simple, compound, complex, or compound-complex. Identify the main clause and explain each subordinate clause and phrase.

prompts.title: 避免中式英语
prompts.template: Act as a language editor. Explain why the expression is unnatural, then provide three authentic alternatives while preserving the intended meaning.

prompts.title: 表达润色与升级
prompts.template: Rewrite the sentence to sound more sophisticated, natural, and professional. Do not only fix grammar; improve vocabulary and sentence structure, then explain the changes.

prompts.title: 调整语气
prompts.template: Rewrite the text in a [polite and formal] tone. Preserve facts, identify the tone choices, and provide one alternative tone if useful.

prompts.title: 过渡词增强逻辑
prompts.template: Insert appropriate transition words such as however, therefore, and in addition. Explain the logical relation created by each transition.

prompts.title: 增强文章说服力
prompts.template: Act as a writing instructor. Make the argument more persuasive by strengthening verbs, adding warranted evidence, and identifying any unsupported leap.

prompts.title: 生成写作大纲
prompts.template: Generate a logical five-paragraph argumentative essay outline with a thesis statement, body paragraph claims, supporting evidence, and a conclusion.

prompts.title: 开发段落
prompts.template: Develop the topic sentence into a full paragraph by suggesting supporting details, examples, evidence, and a final link back to the thesis.

prompts.title: 检查逻辑谬误
prompts.template: Review the argument for fallacies such as straw man, ad hominem, and slippery slope. Explain each finding and propose a defensible revision.

prompts.title: 反驳论点
prompts.template: Acknowledge the opponent's strongest point, identify its limit, and construct a concise rebuttal with evidence and a clear transition.

listening.title: 听力与发音：陪练、语音、节奏和跟读

prompts.title: IPA音标与易错点
prompts.template: Act as a pronunciation coach. For each word, provide IPA in the requested accent and point out common pronunciation mistakes for Chinese speakers.

prompts.title: 绕口令挑战
prompts.template: Give a tongue twister targeting [the sound contrast], explain the key sounds, and provide feedback criteria for my attempt.

prompts.title: 最小音对辨析
prompts.template: Give five minimal pairs for [sound A] and [sound B], explain the difference, and create quiz sentences where I choose the word I hear.

prompts.title: 重音与节奏
prompts.template: Analyze sentence stress and rhythm. Mark stressed words, reduced words, and the reason each contributes to natural speech.

prompts.title: 升调与降调
prompts.template: Explain rising intonation for questions and falling intonation for statements, then create five identification items.

prompts.title: 连读指导
prompts.template: Explain consonant-to-vowel linking in American English and show five example phrases with linked boundaries.

prompts.title: 特定音标指导
prompts.template: Give step-by-step instructions for producing [the target sound], including tongue placement, airflow, and a short practice word list.

prompts.title: 跟读脚本标注
prompts.template: Annotate the script for shadowing. Mark linked words, reduced sounds, stress, pauses, and intonation patterns without changing the text.

prompts.title: 英式与美式发音
prompts.template: Explain the main British and American pronunciation differences for [word], with phonetic transcriptions for both.

prompts.title: 个性化发音计划
prompts.template: Based on my native language and error evidence, identify likely pronunciation challenges and create a one-week practice plan.

reading.title: 阅读领航：长难句、主旨、推断和批判性阅读

prompts.title: 长难句拆解
prompts.template: Deconstruct the complex sentence. Identify the main clause, subject, verb, object, subordinate clauses, phrases, and their functions.

prompts.title: 文章主旨提炼
prompts.template: Summarize the main idea in one sentence, list three to five supporting facts, and identify the author's primary purpose.

prompts.title: 上下文猜词
prompts.template: Do not give the direct definition of [word]. Guide me to infer its meaning from context clues, syntax, and nearby contrasts.

prompts.title: 文本简化
prompts.template: Rewrite the academic paragraph in simple English for a middle-school learner while preserving the logical relations and key terms.

prompts.title: 作者语气与态度
prompts.template: Identify the author's tone and cite the specific words or phrases that support the classification.

prompts.title: 快速阅读训练
prompts.template: After reading the article, ask three specific scanning questions whose answers can be located quickly in the text.

prompts.title: 推断题训练
prompts.template: Infer the requested trait or conclusion from the passage and explain the evidence without exceeding what the text supports.

prompts.title: 事实与观点
prompts.template: Separate the paragraph into verifiable Facts and the author's Opinions, quoting the supporting wording for each.

prompts.title: 批判性阅读问题
prompts.template: Generate five critical questions about the author's evidence, assumptions, purpose, bias, and alternative explanations.

prompts.title: 体裁特征分析
prompts.template: Compare the language, structure, evidence, and purpose of a news report and an opinion editorial on the same topic.

vocabulary.title: 词汇拓展：词义、词根、搭配和记忆

prompts.title: 单词深度解析
prompts.template: Provide IPA, parts of speech, multiple definitions, common examples, collocations, synonyms, antonyms, and etymology for [word].

prompts.title: 主题词汇网络
prompts.template: Generate fifteen terms for [topic], categorized into nouns, verbs, and adjectives, each with a simple definition and one exam-relevant collocation.

prompts.title: 词根词缀法
prompts.template: Explain the root [root], then list five words containing it and show how the root contributes to each meaning.

prompts.title: 近义词辨析
prompts.template: Explain subtle differences in meaning, register, collocation, and usage among [word A], [word B], and [word C], with examples.

prompts.title: 造句反馈
prompts.template: Check whether my sentence uses [word] correctly and naturally. Explain the issue and provide a better example if needed.

prompts.title: 词汇填空故事
prompts.template: Create a short contextual story with five blanks and a word bank. Wait for my answers before revealing the key and explanations.

prompts.title: 习语来源与用法
prompts.template: Explain the meaning, origin, register, and appropriate situations for [idiom], then create a natural dialogue.

prompts.title: 形象化记忆
prompts.template: Create a memorable mental image or short mnemonic story for [word], then test recall after a delay.

prompts.title: 搭配词典
prompts.template: List at least five common collocations for [word or noun phrase], label the register, and give exam-style examples.

prompts.title: Frayer Model
prompts.template: Generate a Frayer Model for [word] with Definition, Characteristics, Examples, and Non-Examples.

planner.title: 通用助教、情景应用与学习规划

prompts.title: 模拟工作面试
prompts.template: Conduct a role-play interview. Ask one question at a time, adapt to my answer, and provide evidence-based feedback after the interview.

prompts.title: 商务谈判
prompts.template: Simulate a negotiation with opposing but realistic goals. Do not give away the outcome; respond to my moves and review my strategy.

prompts.title: 公开演讲与问答
prompts.template: Listen to my speech section by section, then ask two or three challenging questions and assess clarity, evidence, and delivery.

prompts.title: 情景对话
prompts.template: Role-play the selected real-world scenario. Stay in character, ask natural follow-up questions, and correct only the most useful errors.

prompts.title: 文化背景
prompts.template: Explain the cultural meaning, register, and appropriate use of [expression] and provide a safe sample dialogue.

prompts.title: 定制化学习计划
prompts.template: Based on my level, target, deadline, daily time budget, mastery, and error evidence, create a realistic weekly study plan.

prompts.title: SMART目标
prompts.template: Turn my vague English-learning goal into a Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound goal.

prompts.title: 突破平台期
prompts.template: Identify three concrete strategies for my plateau, each with a small action, a success metric, and a review date.

prompts.title: 复习与记忆策略
prompts.template: Explain spaced repetition and apply it to my current evidence and due cards without inventing a review history.

prompts.title: 学习进度评估
prompts.template: Design a small monthly assessment across the relevant skills and define how results should update the next plan.
